description: A union of countable sets indexed by a countable type is countable; in particular this applies to a finite family, including the empty family.
signature:
Set.countable_iUnion.{u, x} {α : Type u} {ι : Sort x} {t : ι → Set α} [Countable ι] (ht : ∀ (i : ι), (t i).Countable) :
  (⋃ i, t i).Countable
